title: Aromatic Quick Turkish Kale Skillet
description: This pungent and springy Turkish dish features kale and is quickly prepared in a cast-iron skillet, making it a great option for a weeknight dinner. It is also Jain-friendly, meaning it contains no animal products or by-products.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped kale to the skillet, stirring to combine with the onion and garlic.
Add the ground turkish red pepper, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Pour in the lemon juice and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 5 minutes, or until the kale is tender.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with lemon wedges if desired.
